entries.name: Period Native
entries.rule_summary: Choose one prepared period/culture for the mission. Routine etiquette, dress, slang, and institutions are familiar unless pressure, rarity, or scrutiny makes the outcome uncertain.

entries.name: Vocal Control
entries.rule_summary: Maintain learned cadence, pacing, accent features, and vocal control through ordinary stress; this does not teach a language or guarantee impersonation.

entries.name: Stress Governor
entries.rule_summary: Ordinary fear, startle, or acute stress does not by itself prevent deliberate action or force a Will roll; extreme psychological effects still function normally.

entries.name: Social Mirroring
entries.rule_summary: After a short exchange, choose rapport, calm, or belonging. Ordinary mannerism mismatch does not impose Disadvantage on your first appropriate social approach to that target or group.

entries.name: Deep Cover
entries.rule_summary: A properly prepared cover identity passes routine verification without a roll; unusual scrutiny, contradictory facts, or high-security checks can still require resolution.

entries.name: Behavioral Baseline
entries.rule_summary: After observing a person in a normal interaction, later attempts to detect a meaningful departure from that baseline may add d4 as a VAM die when relevant.

entries.name: Credential Mesh
entries.rule_summary: When the team has prepared a coherent cover package, routine cross-checks among ordinary documents, roles, and stated relationships do not independently force additional rolls.

entries.name: Social Threading
entries.rule_summary: Maintain two compatible social objectives, roles, or identities in the same scene without ordinary minor distraction penalties; real contradictions still matter.

entries.name: Prepared Contingency
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, establish one plausible earlier social or logistical preparation consistent with your access, mission briefing, and events already established.

entries.name: Behavioral Mastery Model
entries.rule_summary: After meaningful interaction establishes a behavioral model, qualifying rolls with the appropriate Mastered social Skill include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Linguistic Immersion Matrix
entries.rule_summary: After sufficient exposure or reference material, qualifying language, code, accent, and cultural-interpretation rolls include the Skill Mastery Die; it cannot create knowledge with no source.

entries.name: Identity Continuity Engine
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene when a prepared cover is challenged by a new but plausible question, establish one minor supporting detail consistent with everything already known.

entries.name: Consensus Shaping
entries.rule_summary: One successful appropriate social roll may establish a shared immediate objective for a small group instead of persuading members one at a time.

entries.name: Cultural Synthesis
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission after substantial observation of a community, make a Mastery-enabled roll to identify one genuine value, taboo, obligation, or relationship that can open a plausible nonviolent path through the current problem.
